description:
Upcoming earnings dates for stocks in the Stocklake universe.
- days: look-ahead window in days (default 7, max 30)
- limit: max companies to return. Free and guest get at most 5, whatever
  limit says: the companies with the largest market cap, listed by date, each
  counted as one call toward your daily limit. Pro gets up to 500 companies
  per call (default 100) for one call. A window can hold 1,000+ reporters;
  page with offset, or narrow with symbols / min_market_cap / a smaller days.
- offset: Pro only. Skips that many companies (sorted by date). Pass the
  response's next_offset to get the next page.
- symbols: only these tickers (up to 50). Applied before limit.
- min_market_cap: only companies with at least this market cap in USD.
- Returns: { window_days, from_date, to_date, count, total_in_window,
  offset, next_offset, results[] }. total_in_window counts the companies
  that match your filters, before limit/offset; next_offset is null on the
  last page (Free and guest: always null).
- Each result: symbol, name, sector, market_cap, price, rsi,
  earnings_date (ISO UTC), is_estimate, eps_trailing, eps_forward
- Sorted by earnings_date ascending.
- Dates sourced from market data - treat is_estimate=true dates as approximate.
Available to all tiers.

limit.description: Max companies to return. Free and guest: at most 5 (the largest by market cap), each counted as one call toward your daily limit. Pro: up to 500 per call (default 100), one call each.

min_market_cap.description: Only companies with a market cap of at least this many US dollars (e.g. 10000000000 for $10B). Applied before limit.

offset.description: Pro only: skip this many companies (by date) to page through a long window. Use next_offset from the previous response. Ignored for Free and guest.

symbols.description: Only these tickers (up to 50), e.g. your holdings. Applied before limit.

name: get_earnings_calendar
title: Get Earnings Calendar
